attempts.text:
The Rim is as restless as ever, though I'm still waiting for a reason to call it "exciting." The Calder Combine continues to boast about their bounty, reporting that the delta harvests remain robust. It’s a rare bit of prosperity in a wasteland of dust. 

Meanwhile, the Imperial presence remains a shadow on the horizon. Shuttles have been spotted circling the eastern mountains once again. The Sundered Throne remains predictably silent behind its walls, and the Ditch Kings are still lurking where they please. It seems the status quo is the only thing truly thriving out here. Stay safe, or at least stay out of the way of those shuttles.
